transfer.planning_transfer_speed: 10-40 MiB/s plus 60853-file metadata overhead; not measured in this no-large-transfer audit
transfer.planning_duration: 15-90 minutes; execution task must start with a small read-only connectivity/pilot check
transfer.interruption_recovery: Rerun the same rsync commands. Completed files are skipped and partial files resume with append verification. Never rename incoming or delete cloud source after a nonzero exit.
transfer.permissions_preservation: NTFS cannot preserve root ownership/POSIX mode semantics; record source mode distribution and use --no-perms --no-owner --no-group. Source has zero symlinks and hardlinks.

Recompute cloud and Windows archive SHA-256 and logical bytes
